readme: Single source of truth for the E2E upstream mocks. Read by __tests__/e2e/mocks/handlers.mjs (which runs inside the Next server process) and by the Playwright specs. See docs/afp-products/e2e-mocks.md.
rules: One immutable handler set. A scenario is addressed by URL (center id x zone id), never by mutating handlers at runtime — Playwright runs fullyParallel, and Next caches responses across the build and the server.

The one exception is a `phase` product, which is a pure function of NEXT_PHASE: one fixture is baked into the prerender, a different one is served at request time. That is how the freshness path (inventory row X5) is exercised.
Every fixture is a byte-for-byte captured response. Nothing here is hand-authored.

capabilities.note: AFP /v1/public/avalanche-centers — Control 3, the per-center capability feed. Covers all 31 centers, so every tenant's platform gate resolves from this one file.

products.scenario: off-season summary — product_type 'summary', no danger block, no problems
canonical forecast — captured at exactly this center/zone; 4 image media, expired, weather pointer
the zone that also carries an active warning
freshness (row X5) — the product changes between the prerender and the request-time freshness check, which is exactly the correction a reader must see without reloading

absent.note: v2 answers 'no active warning' with a five-key all-null placeholder, not a 404. Every zone without a mapped warning gets this — it is the normal case, not a gap.

No NWAC product goldens exist, so every NWAC zone gets v2's real not-found answer: a 200 carrying the legacy PHP error page. The native page degrades to visible copy, which is what the dvac spec asserts.

Weather product pointed at by v2_public_product_forecast.json. No golden exists at this id, so the Mountain Weather card does not render. v2 would answer 200 with a null-object rather than 404; fetchWeatherProduct treats both as 'no weather product'.
